meaning:
1) to shake, quake
1a) (Qal) to shake
1b) (Pual) to be shaken up, convulsed
1c) (Hithpael) to shake back and forth, toss or reel to and fro
1d) (Hithpoel) to reel to and fro

elsewhere.note: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations of heaven quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.
In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.
Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.
Don’t you fear me?’ says Yahweh ‘Won’t you tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea, by a perpetual decree, that it can’t pass…
